question: Will the number of ERM 2026 candidate homicides reported in Peru exceed two by October 15, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Baseline is 2 Observatorio-documented candidate homicides (Aponte Polo Sep 19; Apurímac district councillor candidate). Campaign rate was roughly 2 in ~3 months, which gives about 10% for an 11-day post-election window, and the motive weakens after the Oct 4 vote while the SER runoff campaign and disputed results keep some risk. Upward adjustment for resolution ambiguity: on Oct 4 the Fiscalía reported '3 homicidios' among 153 pre-election incidents, broader than candidate-only and with no third victim named. Yaranga (Huancavelica, Oct 2) survived. No market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- La República (2026-10-03): the Ministerio Público Observatorio de Criminalidad registered 2 homicides linked to the electoral process: Susy Aponte Polo (Áncash governor candidate, shot Sep 19 in Caraz) and an Apurímac district councillor candidate (bladed weapon, clash between supporters). As of Sep 24: 36 threats, 10 alleged attacks, 66 incidents.
- Infobae (2026-10-02 and 2026-10-04): '38 amenazas contra candidatos, 11 ataques directos y dos asesinatos relacionados con la contienda' (Ministerio Público).
- Ahora / El Comercio / Diario Correo (2026-10-04): the Fiscalía registered 153 'ocurrencias con presunta relevancia penal' in the pre-election stage, of which 96 were threats/intimidation, 17 'atentados contra la vida' and 'tres homicidios'. La Libertad led with 20 cases, Loreto 9. These articles do NOT identify the victims or say whether all were candidates; the 153 set is broader than attacks on candidates. Andina's version of the same report did not mention homicides.
- Infobae/La República (2026-10-03/04): Francisco Yaranga Quispe (APP, Acoria mayor, Huancavelica) was shot at on Oct 2 around 23:30 and survived; logged as attempted aggravated homicide.
- Infobae (2026-05-21): Víctor Hugo Febre, sitting mayor of Veintiséis de Octubre (Piura), was killed by sicarios in May 2026, before candidate registration. Whether he was an ERM 2026 candidate, or is in the Fiscalía tally, was not found.
- First round held Oct 4, 2026; regional runoff (SER) on Nov 29.
- Status quo: tally stays at 2 identified candidate homicides.
- Base-rate material: about 2 identified candidate homicides over the roughly 3-month campaign (Jul–early Oct 2026), all pre-vote; attacks clustered in the final weeks (11+ direct attacks). Post-vote windows historically carry less motive, though disputes and the runoff persist.
- Resolution instrument: Ministerio Público / Observatorio figures where available, else credible reports naming a specific additional candidate victim whose killing is linked to the election or candidacy. A bare aggregate 'homicidios' count without an identified candidate victim is ambiguous.
- Event window: before now through Oct 15, 2026 23:59 PET (deaths on or before Oct 15); as of 2026-10-05 about 11 days remain.
- Market check: none found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.
- Searched without success: identity of the 3rd homicide in the Fiscalía's 153-incident report; any candidate killed Oct 3–5.
calls.reference_class: Election-linked homicides of registered ERM candidates in Peru per ~11-day window during/after the 2026 campaign

calls.reasoning: Status quo: Ministerio Público tally stands at two electoral-linked candidate homicides (Aponte Polo, Apurímac councillor candidate) as of Oct 2-4; no new candidate killing reported on/around Oct 4 election day. Recent near-misses: Yaranga (Acoria, Huancavelica) survived an Oct 2 shooting; Kamarampi (Pastaza, Loreto) died in a river accident, not a homicide. Base rate: ~2 qualifying homicides over ~3 months of campaign implies ~0.15 for an 11-day window at peak intensity; post-vote intensity is usually lower, though contested results and the Nov 29 regional runoff keep some risk, plus a small chance that a previously uncounted killing is surfaced or the accident is reclassified. No human market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Ministerio Público (via Infobae Oct 2 and La República Oct 3, 2026): campaign tally of 38 threats, 11 direct attacks and 2 homicides linked to the electoral process (Susy Aponte Polo, Áncash governor candidate, shot by a hired gunman in Caraz on Sep 19; Apurímac district councillor candidate killed with a bladed weapon during a clash between supporters). Earlier, as of Sep 24: 36 threats and 10 presumed attempts.
- JNE (Emol, Sep 26, 2026): 83 cases of threats, extortion and attacks on candidates across 21 regions.
- Oct 2, 2026 (Infobae/La República Oct 3-4): Francisco Yaranga Quispe, APP mayoral candidate for Acoria (Huancavelica), was chased and shot at about six times and survived; registered as attempted aggravated homicide.
- Oct 1-2, 2026 (Infobae, Andina, RPP Oct 3): Sundi Simón Kamarampi, Renovación Popular mayoral candidate for Pastaza (Datem del Marañón, Loreto), died in a boat collision (river accident). Communities protested and expelled ONPE staff, and the JNE asked for an investigation into the circumstances. Currently reported as an accident, not a homicide.
- Election day Oct 4, 2026 (Infobae): scuffles over alleged 'golondrino' voters in Áncash; the Fiscalía reported 79 arrests for electoral offences. No candidate killing found in election-day reporting.
- Aponte Polo case: three suspects held (alleged Venezuelan gunman, alleged financier, driver); a police chief she had named was reassigned (Peru Support Group, Rio Times, Sep 2026).
- Status quo: the count stays at 2 unless a new killing occurs, an earlier death is reclassified, or a previously unreported killing surfaces.
- Base-rate material: 2 qualifying homicides over roughly 3 months of active ERM 2026 campaign (Poisson rate about 0.65/month at campaign intensity). Post-election windows typically carry lower but non-zero risk (vote-count disputes, runoff campaign to Nov 29 in some regions). No published per-window base rate for post-election candidate killings in Peru was found.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off Ministerio Público/Observatorio de Criminalidad figures or credible-media reporting of a specific additional killing of a registered ERM 2026 candidate that is linked to the election or the candidacy. Staff, relatives and accidental deaths do not count. The death must occur on or before Oct 15.
- Event window: from now until Oct 15, 2026 23:59 Peru time (UTC-5). Per the criteria, any qualifying death up to that deadline counts, including earlier ones reported late. As of Oct 5 03:10 UTC, about 11 days remain.
- Searched, not found: any third candidate homicide reported Sep 29 to Oct 5; any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market on this; any 2022 ERM post-election candidate-homicide count.
calls.reference_class: Election-linked killings of registered candidates during Peru's ERM 2026 campaign (2 in ~3 months), scaled to an 11-day post-election window

calls.reasoning: Baseline: MP tallied 2 candidate homicides (Aponte Polo, Áncash; Apurímac district councillor candidate) as of Sept 29–Oct 2. Hazard of a new qualifying killing in the 11 remaining days is modest (~2 over a 3–4 month campaign => ~0.15–0.25 expected events, lower post-vote but runoff/result disputes continue) -> ~8–10%. Key wrinkle: Fiscalía's Oct 4 pre-electoral roundup reports '3 homicides' among 153 incidents, but that broader tally includes non-candidates (96 threats vs 38 candidate threats); the likely third is a 27-year-old stabbed after a Prin rally in Cusco, not identified as a candidate. Some chance a resolver treats the MP '3 homicides' figure as satisfying the threshold, or that the third victim proves to be a candidate. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.
calls.dossier:
- La República 2026-09-29: MP Observatorio de Criminalidad: 66 penally-relevant electoral occurrences; 36 threats to candidates, 10 presumed attacks; 2 homicides, both candidates (Susy Aponte Polo, Áncash governor candidate, shot 2026-09-19 in Caraz; district councillor candidate in Apurímac, bladed weapon in clash between supporters).
- Infobae 2026-10-02: MP figures 38 threats vs candidates, 11 direct attacks (candidates and teams), 2 homicides linked to electoral process; La Libertad (Trujillo) top region.
- El Comercio / Ahora / Gestión-cited 2026-10-04: MP reports pre-electoral stage total 153 occurrences of presumed penal relevance: 96 threats/intimidation, 17 attacks on life, 3 homicides. Victims of the 3 not named in articles; this tally is broader than candidate-only (96 threats vs 38 candidate threats).
- El Comercio ~2026-09-29: Emerson León Huamán, 27, stabbed to death after a Prin party rally in San Jerónimo, Cusco; article does not identify him as candidate — plausible source of the third MP-tallied homicide.
- Infobae/La República 2026-10-03/04: Francisco Yaranga Quispe (APP, Acoria mayor candidate, Huancavelica) shot at 2026-10-02 night; survived; logged as attempted aggravated homicide.
- Infobae 2026-10-03: Sundi Simón Kamarampi, Pastaza (Loreto) mayoral candidate, died in river boat collision — accident, does not qualify.
- Infobae 2026-10-04: election-day Fiscalía balance: 79 detained for electoral crimes, 12 ley seca; no candidate killings reported on election day.
- Exitosa 2026-10-04: mototaxi union leader shot in Carabayllo on election day — not reported as a candidate.
- Earlier 2026 context: Jorge Alcalde (ex-Senate candidate, general elections) killed Trujillo 2026-04-29; Víctor Hugo Febre (sitting mayor, Piura) killed 2026-05-21 — neither are ERM 2026 candidates per reporting.
- Status quo: tally of identified candidate homicides = 2. Remaining path: new killing of an ERM candidate (incl. elected/runoff candidates) by Oct 15, or third MP homicide being identified as a candidate / resolver accepting MP '3 homicides' figure.
- Base rate: 2 qualifying candidate homicides over the ERM 2026 campaign (~inscription mid-2026 to Oct 4, ~3-4 months), concentrated in final weeks; post-election period typically lower intensity, regional runoff (SER) Nov 29 keeps some campaigns active.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off MP/Observatorio figures where available, else credible reporting of a specific additional killing of an identified registered candidate linked to the electoral process; not off generic incident totals that include non-candidates (though the MP '3 homicides' figure creates resolver-ambiguity risk).
- Event window: deaths through 2026-10-15 23:59 Peru time; as of 2026-10-05 the post-election remaining window is ~11 days (campaign phase largely elapsed).
- Searched but not found: identity of third MP homicide; any candidate killed Oct 4-5; any prediction market (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi/bookmaker) — none found.
calls.reference_class: Candidate homicides linked to Peru ERM 2026 per Ministerio Público, extrapolated rate per 11-day window around/after election day

calls.reasoning: Baseline is two Fiscalía-documented ERM 2026 candidate homicides (Aponte Polo; Apurímac councillor candidate). Targeted searches found no new candidate killing through Oct 4-5; Yaranga survived and Kamarampi's death was an accident. Hazard for the 11 mostly post-vote days is about 6-8%, at a campaign rate of about 0.65/month that declines after the vote, with runoff and result disputes keeping some risk. The Fiscalía's Oct 4 '3 homicidios' within 153 incidents is a broader non-candidate tally with no named victims, but it adds about 5-6% resolver/identification ambiguity. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) whether the Fiscalía's Oct 4 '3 homicidios' (153 pre-electoral incidents) means a third candidate homicide; (2) whether any candidate was killed Oct 3-5; (3) how much hazard remains after the vote. Check 1 (search on the Fiscalía 153 report): result summaries and headlines repeat 153 incidents / 96 threats / 17 attacks on life / 3 homicides with no victims named; the set is broader than candidates (96 threats vs 38 candidate threats), so it does not establish a third candidate victim. This remains an unresolved factual question and a source of resolver ambiguity. Check 2 (searches for candidates killed in October 2026 and after the election): only the Yaranga attempted homicide (survived) and old or unrelated items came up; no new candidate killing found. Judgment: post-vote hazard of about 6-8% plus about 5-6% ambiguity gives 0.13; Run 3's 0.24 overweights the chance that the resolver accepts an unnamed aggregate, and Run 2's 0.08 underweights it.
